crossRefs.note: They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.
Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant…

Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.
